name: centered_pocket_follows_the_centerline
why: ENTRY E18, part (b). A 60 x 40 pocket centred between the sides and 30 from the bottom: the two anchors together, one per axis. The centring is PER AXIS — a midline with its ends on the line of the two sides, perpendicular, and the centre of the pocket at its middle — because the first measurement, with the midline between the MIDPOINTS of the sides, centred in both directions and made the pocket jump in y already at creation. The plate grows towards +X and +Y (entry E2): the pocket must go to x = 30 and stay 30 from the bottom.

expect.tolerance_why: computed by hand: plate 480000 at (0,0,10) minus pocket 12000 at (0,-30,17.5); the hundredth covers the rounding
the dimension is read back in metres
plate 624000 at (30,0,10) minus pocket 12000 at (30,-30,17.5): the pocket went to the middle of the new plate. Had it stayed at x = 0, the centroid would be at x = 30.588
plate 936000 at (30,30,10) minus pocket 12000 at (30,-30,17.5): the bottom has not moved and the pocket stays 30 from it
